title: 1 John
author: John the apostle.
historicalSetting: First John teaches fellowship with God, assurance, love, obedience, and truth concerning Jesus Christ.
keyVerse: 1 John 5:13 — "These things I have written to you who believe in the name of the Son of God, that you may know that you have eternal life."
christFocus: First John centers on Jesus Christ, the Son of God, whose blood cleanses sin and whose life produces love, truth, and obedience.
